description: Windah Basudara's running joke in GTA VI: the heist barely pays, so he would rather race (mending balap). Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-mending-balap/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-mending-balap.mp4): seven pieces (0.6 s padding each) of the stream #7 hour-2 recording (windah-live7/stream-2259-0001.mp4, WIB = local + 22:59) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 1840.00-1841.50 = local 0.60-2.10 -> output 0.00-1.50; K1 t 1226.30-1232.00 = local 3.30-9.00 -> output 1.50-7.20; K2 t 1765.20-1770.00 = local 10.20-15.00 -> output 7.20-12.00; K2b t 1771.80-1775.00 = local 16.20-19.40 -> output 12.00-15.20; K3 t 1805.80-1808.00 = local 20.60-22.80 -> output 15.20-17.40; K4 t 1809.00-1810.85 = local 24.00-25.85 -> output 17.40-19.25; K5 t 1838.20-1841.50 = local 27.05-30.35 -> output 19.25-22.55. Running joke: heists pay next to nothing, so Windah would rather race. Frame-0 teaser = the punchline shot (30:40 'bintang empat, lima ratus dolar', 1.5 s), then stream order: 20:26 on the boat after the getaway, 'mending gua balap ga sih guys? cuma lima ratus dolar' with the 'Non-Lethal' and 'Clean Getaway' toasts (cut ends 20:32, before the character status page that starts ~20:39); 29:25 'mending go balap, ga harus muter-muter ga jelas gini, dapet lima ribu' and 29:32 'dapet dua ribu, ini udah dikejar polisi' (white sedan, 4-star chase, no gunfire or people on screen); 30:06 'balap gue juara satu terus, Joy', 30:09 'lima ratus dolar? What?', and the closing 30:38 'udah capek-capek bintang empat, lima ratus dolar'. Word timings from faster-whisper medium with VAD on short windows (+-5 s). CUT: 20:09 'anjir, cuma 500 dolar', 20:22 in-game 'mereka membunuh anakmu', 20:40-20:55 Lucia bikini status page, 29:22-29:24 'mending go balap, anjir' (swear), the two 'bullshit' lines at 29:59-30:03, 30:42 'babi-babi', 29:35-30:05 filler. Amounts are what medium hears ('500 dolar' x3, 'Rp5.000', 'Rp2.000'); the small model heard '50 dolar'. Check by ear before posting. Digits are avoided in subs (Audex draws 5 like S). No guns, gore, bikini, gambling, real brand or self-promo in the played frames. Main 22.55 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 440x330 at (1480,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'RAMPOK CAPEK-CAPEK', line 2 Volt 'MENDING BALAP', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
